Final end-to-end verification of SPEC-014:

1. zetl theme list shows three bundled themes: default, minimal, docs.
2. zetl theme export default → customise → zetl serve --theme default uses disk copy.
3. zetl theme export minimal → zetl theme list shows 'installed (shadows bundled)'.
4. zetl theme install <real-github-repo> → zetl serve --theme <name> → zetl theme remove <name>.
5. zetl theme install <repo>#<tag> --path <subdir> --name custom-name → verify all flags.
6. zetl build --theme docs produces valid static site.
7. zetl build --theme minimal produces CDN-free static site.
8. Three-tier resolution verified end-to-end.
9. All error paths produce clear, actionable messages.
10. --verbose produces detailed logging for all theme operations.
11. Binary size impact < 100 KB from bundled themes.
12. cargo test passes with no regressions.

All TEST-014-* scenarios.

Modified 8 files (+86, -1003): .hence/context-manifest.json, Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, src/web/engine.rs, src/web/templates/base.html and 3 more

verification_results.theme_export: default and minimal export to .zetl/themes/, show 'installed (shadows bundled)'
verification_results.error_paths: actionable messages for unknown theme, bad repo, non-existent remove
verification_results.verbose_logging: resolution tier shown for each template
verification_results.fix_applied: trimmed decorative CSS comment dashes in base.html files to meet size budget
